name: Limpet
description: A humble cone clamped tight to its favourite rock.

name: Periwinkle
description: A tiny spiral snail grazing along the tideline.

name: Barnacle
description: Feathery legs comb the water each time the tide returns.

name: Anemone
description: A soft crown of tentacles swaying in the shallows.

name: Mussel
description: Anchored by silken threads against the surge.

name: Shore Crab
description: Sidles between the stones, claws raised in greeting.

name: Sea Star
description: Five slow arms map the reef, one cautious step at a time.

name: Hermit Crab
description: Wears a borrowed shell and trades up as it grows.

name: Sea Urchin
description: A patient pincushion of spines rolling through the kelp.

name: Little Octopus
description: Curious and clever, it slips into the deepest pools.

name: Moon Jelly
description: A pale lantern drifting where the tide runs deep.

name: Nautilus
description: An ancient spiral visitor from beyond the shelf.
